title: Shearing the last two coordinates
statement: For a natural number $m$, define a linear map on the product of the $m$-coordinate space with $mathbb{F}_2^2$ by sending $(x,(a,b))$ to $(x,(a+s(x),b+s(x)))$, where $s(x)$ is the sum of the coordinates of $x$.
